posts.headline: Seven editions of chasing the African Bald Fraud ghost and the only fraud left is the idea anyone can catch him — mjwithgoldhoops is 8-10 for 1402.42 points, still the league's gold standard.
posts.detail: A middling 4-average-finish pedigree on paper means nothing when the scoreboard says best record and most points in Busters Anonymous, full stop.

posts.headline: Eight editions deep and Thicks still can't shake the label — 7-3 with a league-worst 1092.54 points-for among winners means this champion is surviving on fumes and a 2025 ring.
posts.detail: A 14-14 career record and a 5.5 average finish is not dynasty behavior, it's a one-hit wonder refusing to admit the hit already happened.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's Put it in Ra is still 3-7 and a 20-8, back-to-back-finalist résumé keeps rotting in last place of the Titty Committee.
posts.detail: A 1.5 average finish and 71.4% career win rate have been replaced by 1070.78 points-for and a season that looks nothing like the Cal Berkeley grad's old dynasty.

posts.headline: Chauncey's talentedtenthh dropped to 2-8 and the name has fully graduated from irony to indictment.
posts.detail: A 12th-place career average finish and 1035.84 points-for confirm this franchise isn't rebuilding, it's just finishing exactly where history says it will.

posts.headline: Nobody's talking about Shake N Bakers at 7-3 with 1361.86 points, and that silence is exactly how triciagloston likes it.
posts.detail: A rookie-ish 6-7-1 career mark says prove-it, but third place in points-for while flying under the radar is how middle-tier teams sneak into real contention.
